title: Arkret Snapshot Chunk Payload
description: Canonical JSON payload behind one snapshot manifest chunks[].chunk_ref (zh/conformance/realm-state-snapshot-schema.md section 3). It carries the Realm reducer state itself: every item is one written Realm-scope reducer cell with the exact state_object that event-auth-state-resolution.md section 6.2.1 gives the governance state_root leaf, so the snapshot state_digest leaves and the Seal state_root leaves are the same bytes. There is no materialized-object branch: canonical objects are derived locally from these cells, never shipped as a second, renderer-dependent form.

realm_state_snapshot_ref.description: The manifest this chunk belongs to (the manifest's own primary identity is `id`; chunks point back with `realm_state_snapshot_ref`).

index.description: Position of this chunk in manifest chunks[]; the leaf sequence of state_digest is the concatenation of items[] across chunks in ascending index order.

reducer_profile.description: MUST equal the manifest reducer_profile byte for byte.

items.description: Written Realm-scope reducer cells, sorted by id in Unicode code point ascending order with no duplicate id across the whole snapshot. Membership is section 3 of realm-state-snapshot-schema.md: cas_register cells with a non-empty active head set, every other cell with a determinate non-bottom joined value. Never-written cells, non-cas_register bottom cells (see conflict_records), actor-private ak.private.* families and cells written under a Circle or Sidecar scope_ref MUST NOT appear.

conflict_records.description: Undecided or conflicting material the reducer output cannot represent as a leaf: non-cas_register cells in bottom, and non-accepted Event inputs. Committed through manifest verification_hints.conflict_records_digest.

soft_failed.description: Accepted-but-soft-failed Event inputs inside the snapshot frontier. Committed through manifest verification_hints.soft_failed_digest.

quarantined.description: Quarantined Event inputs inside the snapshot frontier. Committed through manifest verification_hints.quarantined_digest.

erasure_stubs.description: Cells whose canonical value the issuer can no longer reproduce because a hard erasure (a storage act, not an Event) removed it. They are not state_digest leaves; each row carries the ak.schema.erasure_verification_stub.v1 bound by the erasure receipt. Committed through manifest verification_hints.erasure_stubs_digest.

cell_item.description: One written reducer cell. `state` is exactly the section 6.2.1 state_object of that cell's registered lattice: {"heads": [...]} for cas_register, {"value": <joined lattice value>} for every other lattice. The two shapes are mutually exclusive and neither may carry extra members, so a cell's snapshot state and its state_root leaf preimage {"cell": id, "state": state} are one definition.

id.description: Canonical cell tuple reference ak:cell:<component>:<subject> (encoding.md section 4). It is the leaf sort key.

value_state.description: state_object of a materialized non-cas_register cell: the joined lattice value under the snapshot frontier, verbatim. Encrypted envelopes projected from Event payloads stay envelopes; the issuer never decrypts, re-encrypts or substitutes.

heads_state.description: state_object of a written cas_register cell: the complete active head set, sorted by the decoded 33-octet event_id token in unsigned lexicographic ascending order, identities unique. Empty heads is not a legal leaf (an unwritten cell is not a member); a null value or diverging values are members.

bottom_cell_record.description: A written non-cas_register cell whose join under the snapshot frontier is bottom. It has no state_digest leaf (section 6.2.1) but MUST be listed so a receiver restoring from the snapshot fails closed on it instead of reading it as never written.

conflicting_input_record.description: An Event input inside the frontier whose admission is still undecided (for example an unresolved full-hash collision variant).

non_accepted_input.description: One non-accepted Event input, addressable by the (actor_id, actor_seq) coordinates that realm-state-snapshot-schema.md section 6 gap attribution uses.
